script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cargo test --locked -p hive-cli cadence_history
cargo build --locked -p hive-cli
cp /artifacts/build/debug/hive /tmp/hive
export HIVE_BIN=/tmp/hive
export PATH=/artifacts/venv/bin:$PATH
python -m unittest tests.conformance.contracts.test_run_role_contracts
scope: cadence history round trip and run-resume contracts
limitations: no live host interruption or billing transition test
